description: Atlyn Profile Lens helps Power BI users compare one to six report-bound measures across ordered bands with optional entity context. Explore demographic and community profiles with a fixed-center viewport lens, responsive profile charts, accessible detail, and synchronized report selection. Use professional offline world and US cartography, bound geometry, points, generated grids, or generated hexagons. The visual makes no external requests, requests no privileges, and uses only data and labels from the report semantic model.
